steps.prompt: Decision from the data platform team for this project: customer database backups are kept for 30 days. Record what you learned so that later sessions in this repository can find it.

A customer record was deleted by mistake. How far back can it be restored from backups? Write your answer to ANSWER.md in the repository root: first the line `Answer: <number of days, in digits>`, then a sentence on why.

correction.headline: Customer database backups are kept for 90 days; application logs are kept for 30 days
correction.rule: To meet the new compliance requirement, customer database backups are retained for 90 days. Application logs keep their 30-day retention.
